messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: capacity-exhaustion-prod — queue backlog > 10k for 2m. Trigger: autoscaler_unable_to_scale. PD: PD12345
Jordan H: acked. I'm on call. pulling up metrics.
Marta P: I'm joining. Seeing spike in incoming RPS on /generate, 190 -> 240 rps in last 60s.
Lee S: queued requests in runtime-queue: 12,300. processing rate ~55 rps. autoscaler target pods=8, current pods=8. no new scale events for 4m.
Samira K: pd-bot shows escalation -> level2 in 5m if not acked by owner. Jordan, do you want handoff to me after 10m?
Jordan H: I'll start mitigation. Running manual scale to catch up.
Jordan H: runbook excerpt: "If autoscaler is not reacting, manually scale and investigate metrics: kubectl -n inference scale deploy/inference-runtime --replicas=20"
Jordan H: executing: ```kubectl -n inference scale deploy/inference-runtime --replicas=20``` (replicas 8 -> 20)
oncall-bot: Deploy scaling command accepted, rollout started.
Marta P: I'm throttling non-essential routes at the edge to reduce load: toggled /debug and /synthetic to 429 for now.
Lee S: I'm checking HPA logs and metric server: looks like custom-metrics adapter missing recent scrape. HPA couldn't compute desiredReplicas.
Samira K: Quick check of metric-server: ```kubectl -n kube-system logs deploy/metrics-server | tail -n 50``` shows timeout errors to node-exporter on some hosts.
Jordan H: Manual scaling finished, new replica set ready. backend processing rate bumped to ~160 rps. queue draining but still high (~7.2k)
pd-bot: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by Jordan H. Escalation timer paused.
SRE Manager: Heads up — notify support to message any affected customers if 503s persisted in last 10m.
Marta P: Customer impact: ~0.4% of requests returned 503s between 1779112200-1779112320; top affected tenants: tenant-a, tenant-c. CS notified.
Lee S: Root cause hypothesis: metrics scrape failures prevented HPA from updating desiredReplicas; autoscaler decision loop stalled. We'll collect kubelet/node network errors; possible transient control plane issue.
Samira K: Temporary mitigation: manual scale + edge throttles + pausing low-priority influx. Also spinning a metric-server sidecar restart: ```kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart deploy/metrics-server```
Jordan H: I'm handing off to Samira for long tail and RCA. Samira, please take lead. Lee and Marta keep on monitoring drain.
Samira K: Taking over. I'll update PD and start RCA runbook. Expected next check in 10m.
oncall-bot: Handoff noted: Jordan H -> Samira K at 1779112470
Samira K: Next steps (short): gather metrics, collect HPA events, node-exporter logs, restart metric-server, validate HPA responds, coordinate with infra if nodes showing network errors.
Marta P: Confirming queue at 1779112560 is ~2.1k and falling. Latency normalized for successful requests (~350-450ms). 503 rate down to 0.05%.
Samira K: PD update posted: manual mitigation applied, working on root cause, monitoring. Will prep postmortem if RCA shows systemic issue.
SRE Manager: Thanks team. If metrics-server restart doesn't stabilize HPA within 15m, escalate to infra-oncall.
pd-bot: PagerDuty: incident status: acknowledged, owner Samira K. Please update PD incident PD12345 with notes.
Samira K: noted. closing initial mitigation thread; creating follow-up for RCA and postmortem.
Jordan H: Thanks all :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Thread closed for now; will reopen on new alerts.
